safety_limits: sanitized metadata and synthetic fixtures only
no GitHub mutation, runtime connection, SQL execution, backup, restore, deployment, or production operation
candidate/static evidence does not establish reachability, runtime behavior, authorization, recovery success, RPO, or RTO
all product/runtime/CI results remain NOT_RUN until an eligible fenced lease and required environments exist
title: Immutable asynchronous report/export job scope and worker-dispatch authorization fixtures

job_envelope.dispatch_rule: worker reauthorizes current principal/capability and confirms the immutable scope can only narrow; any widening, revision mismatch or revoked requester blocks execution
job_envelope.visibility_rule: status, notification and download each reauthorize current scope; possession of job ID/token is never authority

cases.synthetic_trigger: client supplies report path, SQL object or template filename
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: reject dynamic target; accept registered report ID only
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: registered report catalog and injection test

cases.synthetic_trigger: client supplies tenant/company/principal or capability generation
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: ignore/reject authority fields and derive on server
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: closed request schema and server derivation test

cases.synthetic_trigger: job waits while role is revoked
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: worker reauthorizes immediately before execution and blocks

cases.synthetic_trigger: job waits while company/warehouse scope changes
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: scope may narrow only after explicit reconciliation; never widen/rebind silently
fingerprint mismatch rejects; no overwrite or second hidden job

cases.synthetic_trigger: report contract/config/build revision changes before worker starts
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: block or explicitly re-resolve as a new reviewed attempt; preserve lineage

cases.synthetic_trigger: worker retries after timeout with unknown renderer/database outcome
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: reconcile durable job/artifact identity before redispatch

cases.synthetic_trigger: artifact generated after requester loses visibility
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: deny notification/status/download content under current authorization

cases.synthetic_trigger: download token is replayed in another tenant/company/session
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: deny and reveal no artifact existence; token is narrow and expiring

cases.synthetic_trigger: job output contains unauthorized hidden field/aggregate
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: field/projection authorization at execution prevents generation

cases.synthetic_trigger: worker consumes stale queue message after cancellation/kill switch
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: expected state/release/config generation CAS rejects dispatch

cases.synthetic_trigger: job metadata is restored ahead of business data/artifact frontier
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: quarantine and reconcile; never advertise successful downloadable snapshot
